headline: Nevish Line Burns Hot as Strand Flares Anew
war_summary: Three hours have sharpened the Nevish Line to twenty changes in two hours and sixty-nine in the day around Princefal, Blackcoat Way and Grief Mother, standing at six Warden, one Colonial and one neutral after 7,064 Colonial and 7,535 Warden casualties in the day with both loss rates still accelerating. The Weathered Expanse has cooled to one change in two hours though fifty-one in the day around Crow's Nest and Shattered Advance, now two Warden, four Colonial and three neutral after 6,595 and 6,968 casualties. Kuura Strand stirs anew with two changes in two hours and twenty-eight in the day at Faden Point and Talven, the latest at the wire, holding five Colonial and one neutral. Marban Hollow and Linn Mercy record no change in two hours after twenty-eight and eleven in the day at Checkpoint Bua and Lathair, Linn Mercy showing a sharp casualty surge to 747 and 731 in two hours without a flip, while the Dead Lands and Callahan's Passage likewise report heavy losses with no recorded turn.
